'''Cyrene silk''' was a luxurious fabric favored by the monarchy of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|Foreign Residence Gown]] was made of black cyrene silk.
